title: OpenGNS: An Open Dataset of the Gradient Noise Scale across Vision, Language, and Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.24331v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The Gradient Noise Scale (GNS) metric measures the signal-to-noise ratio of gradients in stochastic gradient descent and, as shown by McCandlish et al. (2018), can be used to approximate the Critical Batch Size (CBS) during neural network training. Despite its appearance in technical reports of frontier models, no open dataset of GNS measurements across modern architectures exists, limiting systematic study of the metric. We close this gap by releasing OpenGNS, a dataset of more than 400 GNS measurement trajectories spanning three domains: image classification with ResNets, autoregressive language modeling with Generative Pre-trained Transformers (GPTs), and image synthesis with Diffusion Transformers (DiTs), covering models from 11M to 1B parameters trained under Maximal Update Parameterization (muP) with dense batch-size and learning-rate sweeps. translated_title: OpenGNS：涵盖视觉、语言与扩散模型的梯度噪声尺度开放数据集
translated_abstract: 梯度噪声尺度（GNS）指标衡量随机梯度下降中梯度的信噪比，正如McCandlish等人（2018）所示，该指标可用于近似神经网络训练中的临界批量大小（CBS）。尽管GNS出现在前沿模型的技术报告中，但目前尚无涵盖现代架构的GNS测量开放数据集，这限制了对该指标的系统研究。我们通过发布OpenGNS来填补这一空白，该数据集包含超过400条GNS测量轨迹，横跨三个领域：使用ResNet进行图像分类、使用生成式预训练Transformer（GPT）进行自回归语言建模，以及使用扩散Transformer（DiT）进行图像合成，覆盖参数量从1100万到10亿的模型，这些模型在最大更新参数化（muP）下训练，并进行了密集的批量大小和学习率扫描。基于该数据集，我们研究了GNS如何依赖于超参数、规模和训练（过程）……
tldr: 该论文发布了首个开放GNS测量数据集OpenGNS，包含横跨ResNet图像分类、GPT语言建模与DiT图像合成三大领域的400余条测量轨迹，为系统研究梯度噪声尺度与临界批量大小提供了数据基础。
en_tdlr: This paper releases OpenGNS, the first open dataset of over 400 Gradient Noise Scale measurement trajectories spanning ResNet image classification, GPT language modeling, and DiT image synthesis, enabling systematic study of GNS and critical batch size.
